data.one_liner: Feature flagging and A/B testing platform client for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Allows your Flutter application to connect to GrowthBook to toggle features on and off without new deployments, run A/B tests, and track experiment metrics. Supports smart caching, sticky bucketing, and remote evaluation.
use_when: You need to run A/B tests and experiments with statistical significance in a Flutter app
You want to toggle features dynamically via remote configuration
You require user targeting and segmentation rules
avoid_when: You do not use the GrowthBook experimentation platform
You only need simple local configuration files without remote synchronization
strengths: Full support for feature flags, A/B testing, and sticky bucketing
Smart caching with TTL and stale-while-revalidate for offline resilience
Cross-platform support across mobile, desktop, and web
weaknesses: Requires a GrowthBook backend or proxy setup
Major version upgrades can introduce strict breaking changes regarding targeting conditions and type safety
data.setup_notes: Initialize the SDK using GBSDKBuilderApp with your GrowthBook API key and host URL during app startup.
